criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Bold register on all nine; 9 the best, 6 close. The hero is a rounded-box kit SUV on every frame. Frame 3, the declared showstopper, fails: an opaque matte black plane slicing the car, a brown slab where the ledges were asked, lamp hotspots on the cabin glass, lit foliage through dek lines 3 to 5. Frame 4's water mirrors no lamp, an olive grass band, a dead band, the car under half the width. Frame 5's instances read as loaves in tiles. Frame 8's window reads as shelving. Frame 2's figure stands like a mannequin and the pole rises through the dek's right edge.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: Plainly one deck: one world, one hero, one grade, comal meaning one thing; dark track with no strobe; both devices work. Frame 8 slightly outside; frame 2's pool lights from the right.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces, 177 checked by hand; recall facts on the primary record; slide 5's count asserted in code; the April 20th juxtaposition kept in its own sentence. Slide 4's labels are TPR's paraphrase set unquoted.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, who, where and the open fact land; the action real but thin; May 1st unexplained on frame 7.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover earns the swipe, 3 a real turn, 4, 5 and 8 build, 9 returns. Frame 2 could go; 7 partly restates.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Plain, specific, unsensational; a few procedural lines.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: New palette; the sixth staged near-black one-hero deck; one post per day, leaders on a profile, count field and document on a desk repeat recent decks; no. 50's night low water crossing echoed on 3, 4 and 6.

one_sentence_fix: Rebuild frame 3 with the chassis standing-water sheet wrapping the doors, a mud film to the comal line, lit limestone ledges on the far bank and the crowns masked out of the dek.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Opaque matte black plane; brown slab floating at hood height; cabin hotspots; foliage through the dek.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Standing-water sheet with ripple and slight transmission, a grime gradient, ledges on the far bank, no cabin speculars, the crown punched out of the dek.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Flat dark-blue water mirroring no lamp; olive grass band; dead band; car under half the width.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A mirror material streaking the lamps, near black shoulder, a longer lens so the car spans about 60 percent.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Window reads as shelving; the car cropped and illegible; book stack clutter.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: One square window with blinds throwing sodium stripes; the car whole and small under one lamp; cut the books.
Silhouette cues on the LOD mesh; narrower aisles; the hero at the near row.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Mannequin figure behind the tailgate; the pole through the dek's right edge.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: The rider mid-stride beside the rear door; the pole moved right of the dek box.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Lit and unlit posts barely distinguishable; the car closer than the October row.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Pre-April posts near black, a stronger pool on the lit span, the car parked at the October row's depth.
